entities.summary: Sir Abdur Rahim,, sometimes spelled Abdul Rahim, was a judge and politician in British India and later in Pakistan, and a leading member of the All-India Muslim League. He was President of the Nikhil Banga Praja Samiti from 1929 to 1934 and of the Central Legislative Assembly of India from 1935 to 1945.
